13. Test promotion programme

Eligible verified personal GitHub repository owners can request promotion in a separate Sponsored section. Administrator approval precedes test checkout. The introductory test offer is £15 for 30 active days, with no subscription or automatic renewal. There are at most five reserved or running places; paused promotions retain their place. Confirmed repository or demo outages pause the remaining time, which resumes following recovery. Availability is periodically checked and is not guaranteed to be detected instantly. Temporary check errors preserve the previous state.

Test checkout does not charge real money. Test placements are visible only to administrators as previews and are not genuine paid endorsements. Payment does not purchase editorial selection or guarantee traffic, clicks, forks, sales, or a fixed position on every visit. Placements rotate fairly and respect visitor filters. Unpaid checkout reserves capacity until Stripe expires its session. Changes to the approved demo URL or repository ownership may require an administrator refund and a new request. Real payments require a separate launch with completed operator, payment, tax, consumer-rights and promotion terms setup.
